ledger.x: 728: Bappa Rawal sits on the throne of Chitor.

c. 975 (bridge): Munja takes eastern Mewar. "As a result of this victory, the Paramaras gained control of the eastern part of Mewar, including Chittorgarh" (after Munja "defeated the elephant forces of the Guhilas" and "plundered their capital Ahar"). The page dates it only to the later 10th century; the year is the…
1213 (bridge): Chittor and eastern Mewar are again Guhila by the end of this span.
ledger.cp: unknown (page silent; Chittor was Chaulukya by 1151, Guhila page)

wars.name: Paramara conquest of eastern Mewar
wars.outcome: Munja "defeated the elephant forces of the Guhilas" and "plundered their capital Ahar"; the Paramaras gained the eastern part of Mewar including Chittorgarh.

wars.name: Iltutmish's invasion of Mewar
wars.outcome: "Early in his reign, the Delhi Sultanate ruler Iltutmish invaded Mewar, and destroyed Nagada"; no territorial change is named.

wars.name: Siege of Chittorgarh (1303)
wars.outcome: The siege ran from 28 January to 26 August 1303; Alauddin Khalji captured Chittor and gave it to his son Khizr Khan.

certainty.note: No frontier is given on any page; Mewar (Medapata) and Chittor are the only places the pages place.
